test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the purpose of social media sites?

options.text: To provide a platform to replace physical interaction
To provide a platform to decrease loneliness
To keep people online by capturing their interests
To offer a platform for people with anxiety and depression

solution:
The correct answer is To keep people online by capturing their interests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the given statement in the given passage,"the purpose of social media sites is to capture your interest, keep you online, and keep you checking your screen for updates".
 
• Hence, from the above mentioned point we can conclude that '**purpose of social media sites** is '**to keep people online by capturing their interests**'.
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.
